title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2611.29590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derive

translated_title: KernelShift：面向不断演进硬件的内核优化基准测试
translated_abstract: 高效的AI计算依赖于随时间不断演进的硬件，这改变了实现高性能代码所需的策略。对于CPU内核而言，一个关键的演进因素是可用的架构扩展集合，这些扩展提供了专用的硬件指令，从而改变了优化内核所采用的技术。我们研究了编码智能体如何有效地利用这些新的、可能不熟悉的扩展来编写快速代码。我们提出了KernelShift，这是一个用于评估编码智能体在不断演进的CPU架构上进行内核优化能力的基准测试流水线和一组环境。其智能体辅助、人工验证的流水线可将代码仓库转换为基准测试实例，其环境让智能体能够根据目标硬件的反馈来优化代码。利用该流水线，我们从真实且处于活跃开发状态的仓库（ncnn、llama.cpp、Arm SIMD Loops和KleidiAI）中构建了99个内核，包括由此衍生的推理工作负载。
tldr: 该论文提出了KernelShift基准测试流水线，通过从ncnn、llama.cpp等真实活跃仓库中构建99个内核优化任务，并让智能体在目标硬件反馈下优化代码，以评估编码智能体在不断演进的CPU架构扩展下编写高性能内核的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and set of environments that evaluate how effectively coding agents optimize kernels across evolving CPU architectures, constructed from 99 kernels derived from real-world actively developed repositories with feedback from target hardware.
